analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (177,500 KRW) vs SMA5 (192,360 KRW) / SMA20 (208,065 KRW) / SMA50 (233,184 KRW): below short/mid-term trends, confirming weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100 (246,501 KRW) / SMA200 (238,009 KRW): below long-term trends, maintaining weak strength.
· 52-week position (29.2%) + approaching historical low price range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.3→34.8): entering oversold territory, maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (87.7348→-536.7635): continued worsening, confirming bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band at 176,105 KRW): approaching lower band, potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (179,200 KRW): based on 20-day low, first defense line on decline.
· Swing resistance (209,000 KRW): based on 5-day high and Bollinger middle band, potential for trend reversal on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (potential Higher Low formation): confirming attempted rebound within downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.16x): normal level, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (potential accumulation phase within downtrend): consider buying upon RSI oversold exit and MACD improvement.
